newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Oct 3.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Oct 3.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker prices were slightly firmer on Thursday, supported by a strong cargo market and swaps levels. A shortage of 380-cst fuel oil kept supplies tight and the differential to 180-cst narrow. Brokers said the market was generally quiet though with shipowners holding back while they check other bunker centres for pricing. --Singapore Newsroom
